title: fix: retention policy never prunes rooms with a large backlog

target.summary: During history cleanup, cleanRoomHistory broadcasts notify.deleteMessageBulk and deletes read receipts for all message IDs in batch rather than only the messages actually removed. If a message in the batch is pinned or receives a thread reply after selection and is spared from deletion, it remains in the room with its read receipts permanently deleted and clients falsely notified of its deletion.
notes: faulty broadcast and read receipt removal using the full batch instead of only deleted message IDs
helper method re-filters messages during deletion but only returns count instead of which message IDs were deleted
